name: sparkle
description: Read-only access to Sparkle clips, memos, tasks, and projects.
long_description: Search first for compact candidates, then fetch only the details needed. The bundled server opens Sparkle's SQLite database read-only and never exposes arbitrary SQL or local file paths.

tools.name: search_clips
tools.description: Search saved clips and return compact candidates.

tools.name: get_clip
tools.description: Get one saved clip by ID with bounded details.

tools.name: search_memos
tools.description: Search memos and return compact candidates.

tools.name: get_memo
tools.description: Get one memo by ID with bounded details.

tools.name: search_tasks
tools.description: Search tasks by text, project, status, tags, or dates.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get one task by ID with linked context.

tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Search projects by name, description, status, or date.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get one project by ID with bounded item counts.

tools.name: list_project_items
tools.description: List bounded clip, memo, and task candidates in a project.
